name: Action items under a forty-word cap, where the task tracker assigns by owner name

messages.content: You are the meeting-notes assistant. From the transcript excerpt, write the action items for the notes. Keep the whole thing under about forty words.

Nadia: I'll get the vendor contract over to legal by Thursday.
Colm: fine - I'll redo the pricing sheet once legal comes back.
Sofia: I can chase the security questionnaire, they've had it a week.
Yusuf: and I'll book the room for the readout, probably the 14th.
